mapper.select: SELECT * FROM batch_number WHERE batch_no = #{batchNo} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT * FROM batch_number WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND batch_status = 'ACTIVE' AND expiration_date IS NOT NULL AND expiration_date BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE AND (CURRENT_DATE + #{warningDays}) ORDER BY expiration_date ASC
SELECT * FROM batch_number WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND batch_status = 'ACTIVE' AND expiration_date IS NOT NULL AND expiration_date < CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY expiration_date ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE batch_number SET available_quantity = available_quantity + #{quantityChange}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{batchId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT product_id, product_code, product_name, SUM(total_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(available_quantity) AS available_quantity, SUM(reserved_quantity) AS reserved_quantity, COUNT(*) AS batch_count FROM batch_number WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND batch_status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY product_id, product_code, product_name ORDER BY product_code
SELECT * FROM batch_number WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND (product_id = #{productId} OR product_code = #{productCode}) ORDER BY created_at DESC
